mentions.name: Cabreza Command
mentions.description: This platform lets critical infrastructure organizations run their OT security program on live data instead of static documents. It maps to real sites, assets, and operational constraints so teams can actively manage the program, with consulting firms using it to deliver more engagements with the same team and asset owners using it to keep programs alive between engagements.
mentions.problem: Most critical infrastructure orgs manage their OT security program across SharePoint folders, Excel trackers, and slide decks that get updated once a year, so the actual state of the program lives in someone's head.
mentions.audience: Consulting firms delivering OT security engagements and critical infrastructure asset owners running their own programs.
